text: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつは　むし！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつは
structure.en: anyone who doesn't get what's good about Bug Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつ
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase before やつ describes what kind of person it is. むし　ポケモンの　よさが　わからない　やつ = 'a person who doesn't get what's good about Bug Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ swapped in for the い at the end of a describing word turns it into a thing: 'good' becomes 'goodness'. よさ = 'the good side, what's good about it'.
